intro: We support creative people exploring the systems shaping our lives, and developing new ways those systems could work.
copy: Creatives and craftspeople have always shaped the tools, technologies and cultures of their time.

But the tools and platforms surrounding creative work are increasingly designed to extract from it: capturing attention, labour, ideas and intellectual property while concentrating control elsewhere. At a moment of profound change, creatives must have a say not only in how these systems are understood, but in how they are designed.

UNBLOCKED brings creative practice into conversations about ownership, permanence, energy and peers. Supported by a founding grant from Spiral and private patrons, we back work that questions existing arrangements and explores alternatives across culture, technology and everyday life.
